headline: Maui Police Commission Rejects Investigator Recommendation

meeting.body: Maui Police Commission Rejects Investigator Recommendation
meeting.summary: The Maui Police Commission declined to accept a recommendation for its investigator position and deferred the matter to its next meeting.
meeting.recap: The Maui Police Commission held a special meeting that began at 10:15 a.m. on July 29th, 2026.[[0:01:32]] No one signed up to give public testimony, and no written testimony was received.[[0:02:11]] The main item was an investigator position for the police commission.[[0:02:21]] The chair said a commission group had interviewed five applicants and recommended applicant two at the last regular meeting.[[0:02:29]] The commission voted to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) to discuss the applicants.[[0:04:04]] Back in open session, the chair said the commission declined to accept the group's recommendation for the investigator.[[0:04:22]] A motion to bring applicants two and three before the full board for questions was rejected by a vote stated as four to one.[[0:04:56]] A motion to accept the group's recommendation was also defeated by a vote stated as four to one.[[0:05:18]] It was explained that the board needs five votes to take any action.[[0:05:30]] The commission voted to defer the matter until its next meeting.[[0:05:42]] The next meeting is scheduled for August 19th at 10:00 a.m.[[0:06:07]] The meeting was adjourned.[[0:06:15]]
decided: The commission voted to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion).
A motion to have applicants two and three questioned by the full board was rejected.
A motion to accept the group's recommendation for the investigator was defeated.
A motion to defer the investigator matter until the next meeting passed.
meeting.next: The commission will take up the investigator matter again at its next regular meeting.

moments.q: Back in open session: commission declined the recommendation
"There were three motions that were brought."
